timelines.title: Grand Finale: VJ Archana Wins Bigg Boss Tamil 7!
timelines.message: In the Grand Finale hosted by Kamal Haasan, wildcard entrant VJ Archana (Archana Ravichandran) created history by winning Bigg Boss Tamil Season 7! Manichandra finished as Runner-up, Maya Krishnan 3rd, Dinesh 4th, and Vishnu Vijay 5th.

timelines.title: Vichithra Evicted in Mid-Week Finale Elimination
timelines.message: Vichithra was evicted on Day 102 during a mid-week surprise elimination, locking in the Top 5 Finalists.

timelines.title: Raveena Daha Evicted
timelines.message: Raveena Daha was evicted on Day 98 in the final pre-finale weekend elimination.

timelines.title: Poornima Walks Out with ₹16 Lakh Cash Box
timelines.message: During the Cash Box task, Poornima Ravi accepted the ₹16 Lakh cash offer and voluntarily walked out of the show.

timelines.title: Saravana Vickram Evicted
timelines.message: Saravana Vickram received the lowest public votes and was evicted on Day 91.

timelines.title: Family Week Commences
timelines.message: The emotional Freeze and Release task began, with family members visiting the housemates inside the Bigg Boss house.

timelines.title: Cool Suresh Evicted
timelines.message: Cool Suresh received the fewest votes and was evicted during Weekend Ka Vaar on Day 84.

timelines.title: Vishnu Vijay Wins Ticket to Finale
timelines.message: Vishnu Vijay performed consistently in the Ticket to Finale tasks, securing the highest points and becoming the first official finalist of Season 7.

timelines.title: Ananya S Rao Re-evicted
timelines.message: Re-entry contestant Ananya S Rao was evicted once again on Day 77 after getting the lowest public votes.

timelines.title: Dinesh Wins Week 11 Captaincy
timelines.message: Wildcard entrant Dinesh won the Week 11 captaincy task, gaining immunity and leading the house.

timelines.title: Ananya & Vijay Varma Re-enter House
timelines.message: Previously evicted housemates Ananya S Rao and Vijay Varma re-entered the house on Day 70 as wildcard re-entries.

timelines.title: VJ Archana Wins Week 10 Captaincy
timelines.message: Wildcard entry VJ Archana won the captaincy task, taking over as Week 10 house captain.

timelines.title: Jovika Vijayakumar Evicted
timelines.message: Week 9 captain Jovika Vijayakumar received the lowest public votes and was evicted on Day 63.

timelines.title: Jovika Vijayakumar Wins Week 9 Captaincy
timelines.message: Jovika Vijayakumar won the Week 9 captaincy task, securing immunity for the week.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: Akshaya & Bravo
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar saw a double eviction as Akshaya and wildcard Bravo received the fewest votes and were eliminated together on Day 56.

timelines.title: Nixen Wins Week 8 Captaincy
timelines.message: Nixen won the captaincy task to become the Week 8 house captain.

timelines.title: Aishu Evicted
timelines.message: Aishu received the lowest public votes and was evicted from the house on Day 49.

timelines.title: Vichithra Wins Week 7 Captaincy
timelines.message: Senior actress Vichithra won the captaincy task to become the Week 7 house captain.

timelines.title: Gana Bala Evicted
timelines.message: Wildcard entry Gana Bala received the lowest votes and was evicted during Weekend Ka Vaar on Day 42.

timelines.title: Manichandra Wins Week 6 Captaincy
timelines.message: Dancer Manichandra won the Week 6 captaincy task, leading the housemates into the sixth week.

timelines.title: Anna Belle Evicted on Day 35
timelines.message: Wildcard entry Anna Belle received the fewest votes among nominees and was evicted on Day 35 alongside Pradeep's ejection.

timelines.title: Pradeep Antony Ejected via Red Card
timelines.message: Host Kamal Haasan issued a Red Card to Pradeep Antony on Day 35 following formal safety concerns raised by female housemates regarding his conduct, resulting in his immediate ejection.

timelines.title: Maya Krishnan Wins Week 5 Captaincy
timelines.message: Maya Krishnan won the captaincy task to become the Week 5 captain, taking control of the main house duties.

timelines.title: Yugendran Evicted; 5 Wildcard Entrants Enter
timelines.message: Yugendran Vasudevan was evicted on Day 28. During Weekend Ka Vaar, host Kamal Haasan introduced five wildcard entrants: VJ Archana, Dinesh, Anna Belle, Bravo, and Gana Bala.

timelines.title: Week 4 Nominations
timelines.message: Nominations for Week 4 put Maya, Manichandra, Pradeep, Saravana Vickram, Yugendran, and Akshaya in the danger zone.

timelines.title: Yugendran Vasudevan Wins Week 4 Captaincy
timelines.message: Yugendran Vasudevan won the Week 4 captaincy task, securing immunity and leading the housemates.

timelines.title: Vinusha Devi Evicted
timelines.message: Actress Vinusha Devi received the lowest public votes and was evicted from the show on Day 21.

timelines.title: Week 3 Nominations
timelines.message: Housemates nominated Akshaya, Aishu, Maya, Manichandra, Pradeep, Vinusha, and Yugendran for eviction in Week 3.

timelines.title: Poornima Ravi Wins Week 3 Captaincy
timelines.message: Poornima Ravi won the captaincy challenge to become the Week 3 captain, gaining immunity and leadership of the main house.

timelines.title: Vijay Varma Evicted on Day 14
timelines.message: In addition to Bava Chelladurai's walkout, ex-captain Vijay Varma received the fewest public votes and was evicted during Weekend Ka Vaar.

timelines.title: Bava Chelladurai Walks Out
timelines.message: Writer Bava Chelladurai decided to walk out of the Bigg Boss house on Day 11 citing health and personal reasons.

timelines.title: Week 2 Nominations
timelines.message: Nominations for Week 2 put Akshaya, Jovika, Nikitha, Maya, Poornima, Pradeep, Vichithra, and Vishnu in danger of eviction.

timelines.title: Saravana Vickram Wins Captaincy
timelines.message: Saravana Vickram won the "Wrong Turn" maze captaincy task in the activity area, beating contenders Jovika and Nixen to become the Week 2 house captain.

timelines.title: Ananya S Rao Evicted
timelines.message: Ananya S Rao received the lowest public votes in the opening week and became the first contestant to be evicted from Bigg Boss Tamil Season 7 on Day 7.

timelines.title: First Week Nominations
timelines.message: Housemates participated in the first nomination process. Aishu, Ananya, Nikitha, Bava Chelladurai, Jovika, Pradeep, Raveena, and Yugendran were nominated for eviction.

timelines.title: Vijay Varma Becomes Week 1 Captain
timelines.message: Following a verbal debate on launch night where housemates argued why they deserved captaincy, Vijay Varma won the debate and was declared the first house captain of Season 7.

timelines.title: Grand Premiere: Bigg Boss Tamil Season 7 Launch
timelines.message: Host Kamal Haasan launched Season 7 introducing a dual-house concept (Bigg Boss House & Small Boss House). 18 original contestants (Suresh, Poornima, Raveena, Pradeep, Nixen, Nikitha, Vinusha, Manichandra, Akshaya, Jovika, Aishu, Vishnu, Maya, Vickram, Yugendran, Vichithra, Bava Chelladurai, Vijay Varma) entered the house.
